terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.notice: These terms are the basic guidelines for using the WHATPL service. By signing up, you are deemed to have agreed to these terms.
terms.s1_body: WHATPL is a music community service where users can listen to music, upload their own tracks as Creators, and manage their playlists. General members can use features such as music playback, playlist management, likes, and following creators. Creator members can additionally upload and manage tracks.
terms.s2_item1: Registration requires an ID, password, email, name, date of birth, and phone number. Profile image, favorite genre, and creator name are optional.
terms.s2_item2: Members are responsible for keeping their account information secure. A current password is required to change the password.
terms.s2_item3: Only one account can be registered per email address.
terms.s2_item4: ID retrieval and password reset can be done using the name or ID and email address registered at sign-up.
terms.s3_item1: General members can apply for Creator status from My Page, and the application will be approved or rejected after admin review.
terms.s3_item2: Creator members may only upload tracks they have created themselves or have the rights to use.
terms.s3_item3: Uploading tracks, images, or descriptions that infringe on others' copyrights is prohibited.
terms.s3_item4: Creator members can request the deletion of uploaded tracks from the admin, and it will be processed after admin review.
terms.s4_item1: Uploading inappropriate titles, descriptions, images, tracks, or content that may offend others is prohibited.
terms.s4_item2: Abusing other members' accounts, tracks, or playlist features, or interfering with service operations is prohibited.
terms.s4_item3: Manipulating playback, likes, follows, or other features through abnormal means is prohibited.
terms.s5_item1: Admins may delete inappropriate tracks or deactivate accounts in accordance with the service policy.
terms.s5_item2: When an admin deletes a track or restricts an account, the affected Creator or member will be notified.
terms.s5_item3: WHATPL may restrict content exposure, account status, or upload permissions as necessary for stable service operation.
terms.s5_item4: Creator applications, track deletion requests, and account management may be processed after admin review.
terms.s6_body: WHATPL may modify features or temporarily suspend the service for improvements. Important changes will be announced via in-service notices or notifications.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: WHATPL values your personal information and uses collected data only for the purpose of providing the service. By signing up, you are deemed to have agreed to this policy.
privacy.s1_intro: WHATPL collects the following information for member registration and service provision.
privacy.row1_note: Used for login and member identification
privacy.row2_note: Stored encrypted via bcrypt; plaintext not retained
privacy.row3_note: Used for ID retrieval and password reset
privacy.row7_note: Used for profile display within the service
privacy.row9_note: Used as artist name when applying for Creator status
privacy.row10_note: Collected during Creator application; used for review
privacy.s2_item3: User profile management (name, image, genre settings, etc.)
privacy.s2_item4: Providing personalized features such as track upload, playback, likes, and playlists
privacy.s2_item6: Follow-based notifications (e.g. new uploads by followed Creators)
privacy.s3_body: Passwords are not stored in plaintext. They are encrypted using the bcrypt algorithm during registration and password changes, and service operators cannot access the original password. If a password is lost, a new one can be set via the reset function.
privacy.s4_title: Article 4 – Retention & Use of Personal Information
privacy.s4_item1: Collected personal information is stored in the WHATPL service storage and used only for service provision and account management.
privacy.s4_item2: Uploaded audio files and images are stored on the service server and used only within the service.
privacy.s4_item3: Collected personal information is not provided to third parties.
privacy.s5_item1: The admin page and service screens display only information necessary for service operations; sensitive data such as passwords is not exposed.
privacy.s5_item2: Profile images are used for user identification and profile display within the service.
privacy.s6_body: Members can directly modify or delete their name, email, date of birth, phone number, profile image, favorite genre, and creator name from My Page. For other privacy-related inquiries, please use the support center.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about WHATPL.
support.s1a1: Use the 'Find ID' feature on the login screen to look up your registration info.
support.s1a2: You can set a new password using the password reset feature.
support.s1q3: I want to update my account information.
support.s1a3: After logging in, you can update your name, email, date of birth, phone number, profile image, and favorite genre in My Page.
support.s2q1: How do I apply to become a Creator?
support.s2a1: You can apply for Creator status from My Page. Creator features will be available after admin approval.
support.s2q2: What can I do as a Creator?
support.s2a2: You can upload and manage your own music.
support.s2q3: How do I check the result of my Creator application?
support.s2a3: Once the admin processes your application, you will be notified in the service. You can also check the status on My Page.
support.s3q1: Can I add music to a playlist?
support.s3a1: You can select any track and add it to your personal playlist.
support.s3q2: Where can I find the music I liked?
support.s3a2: You can view your liked tracks on My Page or the Home screen.
support.s3q3: Can't I delete the default playlist?
support.s3a3: The default playlist cannot be deleted. You can rename it, and playlists you created can be freely deleted.
support.s4a1: Admins may restrict or remove content in accordance with the service policy.
support.s4a2: If service usage terms are violated, an admin may restrict your account.
support.s4q3: I want to delete a track I uploaded.
support.s4a3: You can submit a deletion request from My Page → My Tracks. It will be processed after admin review and you will be notified of the result.
